supplementalCapture.note: Original Sept 6 source identity covers 76 families; this public capture adds Questionnaire.

accounting.note: 126 individually mapped reference families: 66 BoardUI components, 2 BoardUI foundations, 9 BoardUI templates and 49 Vercel AI Elements components. Questionnaire supplements the Sept 6 inventory with a Sept 7 public capture. Public template compositions are included, not excluded. Five BoardUI showcase routes duplicate these families. Vercel question is public in pinned repository documentation but absent from the website sitemap. AI SDK transport/hooks are behavior APIs, not additional visual components; no runtime adoption is implied.

boardUiDiscovery.discovery_union: All official /components/* pages appearing in sitemap, navigation, gallery, or linked documentation; recursively followed all observed /templates/* routes.

web_run.result: Open/search calls returned no extractable response; official public HTTP retrieval supplied dated verification.

limitations: No claim about unlinked, unpublished, future, or authenticated-only catalogue entries.
No gated Pro source, registry payloads, package installs, bundles, checkout, deployments, or external repository inspection.
Demo datasets (customer names, models, countries, dates) are not component variants.
Documentation headings are retained even where the public prose does not enumerate option names.

Variant pass complete for public headings, prose, rendered labels, and named public examples captured in this retrieval. Arbitrary prop combinations, unnamed choices, and gated-only names are not asserted complete.
No interactive demo acceptance testing; behavior descriptions are documentation claims.
Public-example option observations are intentionally unbound to a parent export: examples can compose children. They are evidence breadcrumbs, not authoritative variant dimensions.
Foundational token values, third-party icons/types, developer tools and sample data are not counted as UI components.

vercelAnatomyAudit.note: Curated pinned-document anatomy, not compiled export parity. Shared headings, subcomponent bullets, shared-props prose, public type imports and Types blocks supplement the original first-heading capture. Edge.Temporary and Edge.Animated were already captured but misclassified as helpers.
